definitions.explanation: Sleeves that end above the elbow, or a garment with such sleeves. Standard summer clothing vocabulary.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{暑|あつ}いから{半袖|はんそで}にしよう。
examples.english: It's hot today, so let's go with short sleeves.

examples.japanese: {半袖|はんそで}では{寒|さむ}いかもしれない。
examples.english: Short sleeves might be too cold.

examples.japanese: まだ{四月|しがつ}なのに{半袖|はんそで}で{歩|ある}いている{人|ひと}がいて{驚|おどろ}いた。
examples.english: I was surprised to see people walking around in short sleeves even though it's only April.

notes:
USAGE:
{半袖|はんそで} is everyday clothing vocabulary. When discussing what to wear based on the weather or season, {半袖|はんそで} and {長袖|ながそで} are the standard pair.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {半袖|はんそで}のシャツ (short-sleeved shirt)
- {半袖|はんそで}Tシャツ (short-sleeved T-shirt)
- {半袖|はんそで}で{出|で}かける (to go out in short sleeves)

RELATED WORDS:
- {長袖|ながそで}: long sleeves
- {袖|そで}: sleeve
- {袖|そで}なし: sleeveless
